defects.problem: Highlight is a hard-edged white rectangle pasted over the dimmed screenshot. It clips the 'Update payment method' label ('method' touches the patch) and shows stray redaction fragments above the Cancel button. It looks like a patch, not a highlight.
defects.fix: Remove the white backing or match it to the screen. Keep only the yellow ring. Re-crop so no redaction fragments show inside the patch.

defects.problem: The '1' badge sits on top of the billing address redaction bar and splits it. The Expiry redaction bar runs past the Expiry field into the CVC column, so the redactions look misaligned and sloppy.
defects.fix: Move the badge clear of the redaction bar, for example left of the button. Align the redaction bar widths to their fields.

defects.problem: The screenshot is dimmed heavily and shown at about 60% of frame width. The highlighted 'Cancel subscription' text is about 12px high at 1080p and unreadable at small size. The dimming lowers contrast on the one control the section is about.
defects.fix: Lighten the dim. Let the screenshot fill more of the left side. Stay within the current layout.

defects.problem: The burned caption at the bottom-left repeats the right-hand headline ('In a 2025 study of 1,173 older internet users,' with '1,173 older internet users surveyed'). The 'Frame held.' line under it is odd copy. Large dead space sits below the screenshot and right of the caption.
defects.fix: Drop the duplicate headline text. Move the label and caption closer to the screenshot. Delete 'Frame held.'

defects.problem: The screenshot is shown at the same size as the hero text, but the 'Where do I press?' title has no breathing room: it is cramped on three lines with a gap to the subtitle. The cursor in the later frames floats at the right of the screenshot, away from the button, with no motion trail.
defects.fix: Set the title on two lines if it fits. Put the cursor on or near the Cancel button.

defects.problem: The jump from the clean white screenshot to the dimmed, redacted version with the highlight is a state swap. The sheet shows no intermediate frame, so I cannot tell if it is a clean dissolve.
defects.fix: Confirm it is a short dissolve, not a hard cut.

couldNotAssess: Motion, easing and whether the 5s state change is a dissolve
oneLineVerdict: Stable, honest and clean with no zoom or drift, but the pasted white highlight patch, the misaligned redaction bars and the dim, small screenshot keep it short of top polish.
